show: How to Get Away with Murder
seoTitle: How to Get Away with Murder Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the How to Get Away with Murder test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Annalise, Wes, Connor, Michaela, Asher, Laurel, Frank or Bonnie — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the mastermind, the charmer, or the loyal right hand? Answer 11 everyday questions about friends, pressure and secrets, and find out which How to Get Away with Murder character you are.

characters.name: Annalise Keating
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Brilliant, commanding and fiercely protective. You're always three steps ahead, and you'll do anything for your people.
description: Like Annalise, you're brilliant under pressure. She's a criminal defense attorney and a law professor in Philadelphia.
You'd do anything for your people. Annalise is capable of anything to get what she wants, and to protect those she loves.
You've reinvented yourself. Annalise was born Anna Mae Harkness, and she built a whole new life.
characters.flaw: You'd rather control everything than let anyone see you hurting.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a cold stare and a plan nobody else can see.
characters.clashReason: they'd take your argument apart in front of everyone

characters.name: Wes Gibbins
characters.title: The Good Heart
characters.summary: Kind, earnest and always eager to help. You see the best in people, even when you shouldn't.
description: Like Wes, you're kind and eager to help. He gets into Middleton University off the waitlist, and he's chosen for Annalise's student team.
You want to do the right thing. Wes is smart and sweet, and he's often the group's conscience.
Your story matters. Wes's son, Christopher, grows up to look just like him.
characters.flaw: You trust the wrong people too easily.
characters.signature: A worried look, a big heart and a promise you'll keep.
characters.clashReason: they'd lose sleep over something you'd already forgotten

characters.name: Connor Walsh
characters.title: The Charmer
characters.summary: Clever, charming and a little bit dangerous. You know how to get what you want, and you're softer than you let on.
description: Like Connor, you're clever and charming. He's one of Annalise's students, and he knows how to use his charm to get ahead.
You've got a softer side. Connor falls for Oliver, a hacker he first meets while digging up information for a case.
You go all in. Connor and Oliver marry, and they're still together years later.
characters.flaw: You hide your feelings behind sarcasm and flirting.
characters.signature: A smirk, a sarcastic comeback and a plan you're not sharing.
characters.clashReason: they'd charm you into it, then deny everything

characters.name: Michaela Pratt
characters.title: The Overachiever
characters.summary: Confident, polished and determined to win. You've got a plan, and nobody is getting in your way.
description: Like Michaela, you're confident and polished. She's one of Annalise's students, and she wants to be as successful as Annalise.
You can talk your way through anything. Michaela is sophisticated and silver-tongued.
You make it to the top. Years later, Michaela becomes a judge.
characters.flaw: You'd put your career ahead of your friends.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a five-year plan and a sharp tongue.
characters.clashReason: they'd remind you they're the top of the class

characters.name: Asher Millstone
characters.title: The Jokester
characters.summary: Goofy, loyal and always trying a little too hard. You want everyone to like you, and you mean well.
description: Like Asher, you love a joke. He's one of Annalise's students, and he comes from a family of lawyers.
You can be a bit much. Asher is a privileged jokester, and his childish side means he's often left out.
You end up in the thick of it. Asher starts on the outside of the group, but he ends up right in the middle of its secrets.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to fit in that you don't know when to stop.
characters.signature: A bad joke, a big grin and a nickname nobody asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke at the worst possible moment

characters.name: Laurel Castillo
characters.title: The Quiet One
characters.summary: Quiet, observant and darker than you look. You notice everything, and you're tougher than anyone thinks.
description: Like Laurel, you notice everything. She's one of Annalise's students, and she went to law school to help people less fortunate than her.
You're tougher than you look. Laurel is talented, ambitious and darker than anyone expects.
Family is complicated for you. Laurel is the daughter of Jorge Castillo, a powerful businessman she learns not to trust.
characters.flaw: You keep your plans to yourself until it's too late to help.
characters.signature: A quiet voice, a sharp eye and a plan nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd say nothing, then surprise you with what they knew

characters.name: Frank Delfino
characters.title: The Fixer
characters.summary: Loyal, discreet and a little reckless. You handle the jobs nobody else will, and you don't ask questions.
description: Like Frank, you handle the jobs nobody else will. He works for Annalise's firm, taking care of things that need discretion.
You act fast. Frank can be reckless, but he's devoted to Annalise.
Your love life is complicated. Frank and Bonnie have an on-and-off relationship.
characters.flaw: You act first, and think about the consequences later.
characters.signature: A quiet nod, a phone that's always on and a job you'll never talk about.
characters.clashReason: they'd fix your problem without asking how you wanted it fixed

characters.name: Bonnie Winterbottom
characters.title: The Loyal Right Hand
characters.summary: Devoted, hard-working and always keeping the peace. You'd do anything for the people you believe in.
description: Like Bonnie, you're fiercely loyal. She's an associate attorney, and Annalise's right-hand woman.
You keep the peace. Bonnie works hard to make things right for Annalise.
You find your own path. Bonnie later becomes a state prosecutor.
characters.flaw: You give so much to others that there's nothing left for you.
characters.signature: A neat file, a worried smile and a promise you'll never break.
characters.clashReason: they'd take someone else's side, out of loyalty

questions.text: Your study group falls apart the night before a big exam. You...

options.text: Take control, and tell everyone exactly what to do
Study alone. You'll do better than all of them anyway
Order pizza, and hope someone else has the notes
Stay up all night helping whoever's struggling most

questions.text: You've got the whole weekend to yourself. You...

options.text: Go out, flirt a little and see where the night takes you
Disappear for the weekend without telling anyone
Stay home, alone, and finally exhale
Spend it fixing something for someone else

questions.text: A friend asks you to keep a dangerous secret. You...

options.text: Keep it, and handle anything that comes up yourself
Agree, then lose sleep over it every night
Ask exactly how this could affect your career
Promise to keep it, and mean it, whatever it costs

questions.text: You're at a fancy dinner with important people. You...

options.text: Make sure every single person remembers you
Make a joke that lands very badly
Charm the most interesting person there
Watch everyone quietly, and notice what nobody else does

questions.text: Someone you look up to lets you down. You...

options.text: Defend them anyway. You owe them everything
Confront them directly, even though it scares you
Make a cutting remark, then pretend you don't care
Say nothing, and start making your own plan

questions.text: You're under huge pressure at work. You...

options.text: Get colder and sharper, and win anyway
Keep smiling, and smooth things over for everyone
Crack jokes, and hope nobody notices you're panicking
Do whatever it takes to make the problem disappear

questions.text: Someone is spreading lies about you. You...

options.text: Destroy their credibility, in public
Laugh it off, then quietly get even
Dig up the truth, and prove them wrong
Try far too hard to get everyone to like you again

questions.text: A stranger starts hanging out with your friends. You...

options.text: Welcome them, and make them feel at home
Size them up, and decide whether they're worth knowing
Look into their background, just to be safe
Give them a nickname within five minutes

questions.text: Your closest friend calls you in a panic at 2 a.m. You...

options.text: Get there first, and take care of it
Calm them down, and work out a plan together
Go straight away, and worry the whole way there
Stay calm, and start thinking three steps ahead

questions.text: You're a law student, and your professor asks you to help cover something up. You...

options.text: Go along with it, and hope your career survives
Refuse, then end up helping anyway
Agree, mostly so you won't be left out
Help, and quietly keep a record of everything

questions.text: You work for a powerful lawyer with a lot of secrets. You...

options.text: Do whatever they need, no matter what
Handle the jobs nobody else will touch
Use what you know to your advantage
Learn everything, so one day you can take their place
